description: Normalized financial statements for any SEC filer by ticker or CIK, straight from EDGAR XBRL: revenue, gross profit, operating income, net income, EPS, assets, liabilities, equity, cash, debt, operating cash flow, capex and free cash flow per fiscal year or quarter, with margins, current ratio, leverage, ROE and YoY growth. Handles concept switches (ASC 606) and IFRS 20-F filers; lists the XBRL concepts used. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sec-financials

cik.description: SEC CIK instead of a ticker (e.g. 320193)

limit.description: Periods to return, newest first (1-12, default 4)

ticker.description: US-listed operating company ticker (e.g. AAPL, BRK-B). Aliases: symbol, company
